title: docs/reference/quest-board-hooks-module-in-the-opum-quest-plugin.md still describes --across-refs as folding every same-id pair into one task
description: Found by the QCLI-432 confirmatory review. docs/reference/quest-board-hooks-module-in-the-opum-quest-plugin.md:118 states that `quest task list --across-refs` "treats the same id on two refs as two states of one task and picks no winner". Since QCLI-432 that is only the identity:"task" case; a genuine collision (two different records sharing an id) is reported as identity:"collision". The doc is QCLI-431's record and was outside QCLI-432's AC4-named doc scope, so it was not charged to that change. Filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction; UNSTAMPED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The doc states that --across-refs reports a genuine id collision as identity:"collision" rather than folding it into one task's states, matching the shipped behaviour
